content.short: Rhodium, the rarest and most valuable precious metal in the world on the Cardano Blockchain. We bring you your store of value.
content.description:
Rhodium Coin is a Store of Value asset built on the Cardano Blockchain. The Rhodium Coin name was inspired by the rare and most expensive precious metal on Earth, which is represented by our limited supply of only 1,000,000. Rhodium Coin uses unique and engaging distribution methods such as the Rhodium Vaults, Rhodium Pirates, and the Rhodium Rewards Coin. Our main goal at Rhodium Coin is to build partnerships with others to make Rhodium Coin a usable asset and the go to Store of Value on Cardano.

Rhodium Vault NFTs represent 250 RHOD each, with a limited supply of 400 NFTs. 100,000 RHOD will be dedicated to the Rhodium Vaults, 10% of the total supply of Rhodium Coin. The mint price is 250 ADA for one Vault, 450 ADA for two Vaults, and 600 ADA for three Vaults. Limit of three Rhodium Vaults per mint transaction. In September 2025, 125 RHOD will be released to each Rhodium Vault holder's wallet. September 2027, the remaining 125 RHOD will be released to each holder. Both releases will be automatically distributed at no cost to the holders. The Rhodium Vault NFTs will be staked on the Cardano Lands platform, which will earn holders additional rewards. The Rhodium Coin Team has acquired 250,000 EXO tokens, which is the minimum amount to secure the ''High League'' position on Cardano Lands. This will maximize rewards for all holders in addition to airdrops of new items on the Cardano Lands platform.

Mint Your Rhodium Vault today: https://www.rhodiumcoin.net/vault

‍ Rhodium Pirates are limited supply (150) NFTs that earn holders 25 RHOD per month, per Pirate held. Each Pirate has its own unique traits. All Rhodium Pirates have been minted and are available to trade on the JPG Store.

‍ https://www.jpg.store/collection/rhodiumpirates

‍ The Rhodium Rewards Coin rate is 0.1 RHOD per RHOD staked (10% APY). Rewards will be distributed to all holders on July 1st, 2023. Snapshots will be taken monthly, if you buy or sell RHOD, it will be taken into account each month. This process will concur until all 80,000 RHOD dedicated to the Rewards Coin is gone. You must hold RHOD in order for the Staking NFT to earn rewards. Only one Staking NFT per RHOD wallet.

Mint Your Rhodium Rewards Coin: https://www.rhodiumcoin.net/staking
